items.hed: Houston placed linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair on injured reserve Tuesday and signed Sabastian Harsh to the practice squad, one day before Thursday night's game against the Colts
items.insight: The club's transactions page lists the Al-Shaair move dated Nov. 17, along with the release of Junior Tafuna from the practice squad. The Week 11 injury report, still showing Monday and Tuesday practice columns ahead of Wednesday's short-week session, has Al-Shaair's teammates Marvin Harrison Jr., Danielle Hunter, Brevin Jordan and Woody Marks as did-not-practice on both days, while running back David Montgomery was a full participant both days. The team page lists Thursday, Nov. 19, against Indianapolis.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still.

items.hed: Houston protected pitcher Jackson Nezuh from the Rule 5 Draft by adding him to the 40-man roster and outrighted outfielder Joey Loperfido to Sugar Land
items.insight: MLB.com reported the Tuesday move left the Astros at 39 players on the 40-man. Nezuh, the club's No. 16 prospect, split 2026 between Corpus Christi and Sugar Land at 4-3 with a 3.83 ERA and 124 strikeouts in 103 1/3 innings. Loperfido had hip surgery last month and is not expected to be ready for the start of spring training; he must clear waivers to stay in the organization. The Rule 5 Draft is set for Dec. 9 in San Diego.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium, Houston, Feb. 5, 2017. Venue still. Astros are in their off-season.

items.hed: Houston plays at Indiana tonight at 7 p.m. ET, the third game of a road trip that already includes a win in Washington and a loss in Miami
items.insight: The Rockets' official schedule lists tonight's game at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, status 7 p.m. ET, after a 147-119 win at Washington on Nov. 15 and a 110-128 loss at Miami on Nov. 16. The next game after Indiana is at Denver on Friday.
